The logbook is a record of everything you do.
 Open the logbook whenever you want to see what 
you have done so far. You can write in the logbook 
in the Notes column.

There is plenty of useful information in the newspapers.
 Sometimes, this can help you earn a big profit.
When you need more information to make an important
 decision,  look in the newspapers. Tip: Answers to some
 trivia-card  questions are in the newspapers.

You can keep diary of your life in the family album and 
choose pictures to add to it. You can print out the album.

One of your goals is to save enough money to fulfill your
 dreams. Banks did not have personal savings accounts 
at this time. To save money,
hide it in this secret place at home.
